name: Complete one eligible Sengoku Civic and request the official Tier 1 Government in the same turn

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; local w=b.Tier1GovernmentWindowCivic(); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='TIER1_GOVERNMENT_BLOCKED' and g.stage=='NO_CIVIC_COMPLETED_THIS_TURN' and g.currentType=='GOVERNMENT_CHIEFDOM' and g.target.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY' and g.target.civicOwned and g.target.unlocked and w and w.prerequisites>0 and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'Tier 1 window or original captive differs'); b.Queue('PREPARE_TIER1_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC'); return w.civicType

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PREPARE_TIER1_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC' or a=='UNKNOWN_PREPARE_TIER1_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC' or a=='REJECTED_PREPARE_TIER1_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PREPARE_TIER1_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC' or a=='PENDING_PREPARE_TIER1_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC'

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local a=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC_ATTEMPT'); local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC_RECEIPT'); local g=b.ReadCapacityGovernment('Tier1'); return a and r and a.turn==Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() and r.token==a.token and r.phase=='SETTER_RETURNED' and r.status=='OBSERVED' and r.owned and r.afterTotal==a.beforeTotal+a.expectedTitleDelta and r.afterSpent==a.beforeSpent and g.stage=='READY_CHANGE' and g.civicCompletedThisTurn and g.target.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY' and g.target.unlocked

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.ReadCapacityGovernment('Tier1').stage=='READY_CHANGE','official Tier 1 Government window closed'); b.Queue('CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'); return 'official Oligarchy request queued in Civic completion turn'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='REJECTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' then error(a) end; return a=='REQUESTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'

local i=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_INTENTS'); local a=i and i.Tier1; local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return a and p and p:IsTurnActive() and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()==a.turn+1

local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='REJECTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='PENDING_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; local a=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC_ATTEMPT')); local c=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_GOV_WINDOW_CIVIC_RECEIPT')); local i=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_INTENTS')).Tier1; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_READ')); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='BUILD_TIER1' and p.buildingType and g.currentType=='GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY' and g.currentTier=='Tier1' and a.turn==i.turn and c.token==a.token and c.status=='OBSERVED' and c.afterTotal==a.beforeTotal+a.expectedTitleDelta and c.afterSpent==a.beforeSpent and i.status=='PREPARED' and i.sourceCivicToken==a.token and i.sourceCivicType==a.civicType and i.sourceCivicDelta==a.expectedTitleDelta and i.beforeTotal==c.afterTotal and i.beforeSpent==c.afterSpent and r.status=='OBSERVED' and r.nativeSource=='UI_NATIVE_CULTURE' and r.governmentIndex==i.targetIndex and r.governmentType==g.currentType and r.governmentTier==g.currentTier and r.sourceCivicOwned and r.sourceCivicIndex==a.index and r.originalToken==i.token and r.originalTurn==i.turn and r.turn==i.turn+1 and r.total==i.beforeTotal and r.spent==i.beforeSpent and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'native Tier 1 Government, exact title accounting or original captive differs'); return p.stage
